critical_code_review_comments: monetization_usage.py _get_threshold_and_duration default fallback is hard_skip_limit=6 (line 108) but the actual seeded app_settings value is 9. Not a bug — default only used if the collection is entirely empty. Minor: consider aligning default with the seeded baseline for consistency.

monetization_usage.py _resolve_user (lines 73-81) treats a Bearer token as a possible session_token fallback for the web path. This is defensive but means a leaked mobile Bearer could potentially match a session record if IDs ever collide — currently safe since Bearer tokens are 'tok_<uuid>' and session tokens are distinct, but worth a note.

monetization_usage.py POST /reset (line 238) is idempotent + upserts. It will create a billing_stats doc even for a premium user who never skipped, which is harmless but adds a row per premium upgrade. Acceptable.

The record-skip 'prompt_hard' fires only on the EXACT crossing skip (usage == threshold). This matches the spec but means if the crossing response is lost in transit the client won't be re-prompted server-side. Client's local counter still triggers the modal, so acceptable.
